attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family with the per-TU flags in configure.py

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: Retail reloads member pointers per use across calls at most late sites (fresh `p->field` spellings each time); block-local pointer caches are correct only where the target holds the value in a saved register through the block. Record-array access goes through a pointer local (`u8* rec = Base + idx * stride;`) so +disp folds into lwzu/lwzx forms. Element addresses of a small vector read twice across a call will address-PRE into saved registers unless spelled as named members.
